capabilities: Create new CSV files from the command palette, ribbon or folder menu
Open and view .csv files in a pane on desktop and mobile
Edit CSV, TSV and JSON files with optional AutoSave
Edit JSON with syntax highlighting while keeping compact files compact on save
Reload a CSV changed elsewhere and warn about unsaved local edits
extras: The WASM viewer assets are embedded in main.js and written into the plugin directory on load; no telemetry and no runtime code download. Only one of csvzall Lite and csvzall should be enabled at a time because both register as the CSV file handler. Charts, SQLite queries and large-file viewing through a helper process are only in the desktop plugin.
intentEvidence: csvzall Lite is a lightweight alternative to csvzall for Obsidian
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit CSV files on its own, and desktop CSV tools that rely on a helper binary do not work on phones and tablets.

relations.evidence: csvzall Lite is a lightweight alternative to csvzall for Obsidian

summary: CSV viewer and editor that opens .csv files in an Obsidian pane on desktop and mobile using a bundled WASM viewer.
